name: Downs
short: Four tries to gain 10 yards, then it resets.
full: The offense gets four tries, called downs, to move the ball 10 yards. Make it, and they get a fresh 1st down.
detail: 4 downs to gain 10 yards. Gain them and it's 1st down again.

name: The yellow line
short: Yellow line: reach it for a new 1st down.
full: The yellow line shows where the offense must reach to earn a new 1st down. It's a TV graphic; on the field, sideline chains mark it.
detail: A TV graphic. On the field, chains on the sideline mark the spot.

name: Line of scrimmage
short: Blue line: where the ball sits before the play.
full: The line of scrimmage is where the ball sits before a play, the blue line on our field. Neither side may cross it before the snap.
detail: Blue line on our field. Nobody crosses it before the snap.

name: The snap
short: Every play starts with the snap.
full: Every play starts with the snap: the center passes the ball back between his legs to a teammate.

name: 3rd down
short: 3rd down is the big one.
full: 3rd down is the big one. If the offense fails here, it usually punts or tries a field goal on 4th down.

name: Red zone
short: Inside the opponent's 20: best scoring chances.
full: The red zone is inside the opponent's 20-yard line. Scoring chances are highest here.

name: & Goal
short: & Goal: score, or no new set of downs.
full: When the goal line is closer than 10 yards, it's "& Goal": the only way to get a new set of downs is to score.

name: Touchdown
short: Ball in the end zone: 6 points.
full: A touchdown is carrying or catching the ball in the opponent's end zone. It's worth 6 points, then the team gets a bonus try.
detail: 6 points, then a bonus try: a kick for 1 or a play for 2.

name: Extra point
short: Short kick after a touchdown: 1 point.
full: After a touchdown, the team usually kicks a short extra point through the uprights for 1 more point.

name: Two-point try
short: Skip the kick, run one play from the 2: 2 points.
full: Instead of kicking after a touchdown, a team can run one play from the 2-yard line. Reaching the end zone is worth 2 points.
detail: One play from the 2-yard line. Worth 2 points instead of 1.

name: Field goal
short: Kick through the uprights: 3 points.
full: A field goal is kicking the ball through the uprights during a play. It's worth 3 points.

name: Safety
short: Tackled in your own end zone: 2 points for defense.
full: A safety is when the offense gets tackled in its own end zone. The defense scores 2 points and also gets the ball back by a free kick.
detail: 2 points to the defense, plus the ball back by a free kick.

name: 4th-down decision
short: 4th down: go for it, punt, or kick.
full: On 4th down the coach chooses: go for it, punt it away, or kick a field goal. Falling short when going for it gives the other team the ball there.

name: Turnover on downs
short: Fell short on 4th: other team takes over.
full: The offense went for it on 4th down and fell short, so the other team takes over right at that spot.

name: Punt
short: Kick it away on 4th to pin them back.
full: A punt is a kick on 4th down. It gives the ball away, but pushes the other team farther back.

name: Punt return
short: Returner catches the punt and runs it back.
full: On a punt return, the receiving team's returner catches the punt and tries to run it back up the field.

name: Fair catch
short: Arm waved: can't be hit, can't run.
full: The returner waved an arm above his head for a fair catch. Nobody can hit him, but he can't run after catching.

name: Kickoff
short: The kick that starts each half and follows scores.
full: A kickoff starts each half and follows every score. One team kicks the ball deep to the other.

name: Touchback
short: Kick downed in the end zone: no return.
full: A touchback is a kick downed in or through the end zone. There's no return; the receiving team starts from a set spot.
detail: For punts, that spot is the receiving team's own 20.

name: Interception
short: Defender catches the pass: defense takes the ball.
full: An interception is when a defender catches a pass. The defense takes the ball.

name: Fumble
short: Dropped ball: whoever recovers keeps it.
full: A fumble is when a ball carrier drops the ball. Whoever recovers it keeps it.

name: Sack
short: Quarterback tackled behind the line before throwing.
full: A sack is when the quarterback gets tackled behind the line of scrimmage before he can throw.

name: Incomplete pass
short: Pass hit the ground: clock stops, ball goes back.
full: The pass hit the ground, so the play is over. The ball goes back to where it started and the clock stops.

name: Game clock
short: Four 15-minute quarters; some plays stop the clock.
full: The game has four 15-minute quarters. The clock stops for incomplete passes, scores, timeouts, and some plays out of bounds.

name: Play clock
short: About 40 seconds to start the next play.
full: The offense usually has 40 seconds to start the next play. If time runs out, it's a delay-of-game penalty.

name: Two-minute warning
short: Automatic pause at 2:00 left in each half.
full: The two-minute warning is an automatic pause when 2:00 is left in each half.

name: Timeout
short: Three per half to stop the clock.
full: Each team gets three timeouts per half. A timeout stops the clock.

name: Running out the clock
short: Leading late: stay in bounds, burn the play clock.
full: A team ahead or tied late keeps the ball in bounds and uses its whole play clock, so the other team gets less time.

name: Kneel-down
short: Kneel right after the snap; clock keeps running.
full: The quarterback kneels right after the snap. It ends the play safely while the clock keeps running.

name: Spike
short: Ball thrown into the ground to stop the clock.
full: A spike is the quarterback throwing the ball straight into the ground to stop the clock. It uses up a down.

name: Coach's challenge
short: Red flag: coach asks for a replay review.
full: A coach threw a red flag to ask for a replay review. If the coach loses the challenge, the team loses a timeout.

name: Replay review
short: Call changes only with clear and obvious evidence.
full: Officials are watching replays. They change the call only with clear and obvious evidence. Scoring plays and turnovers are reviewed from the booth.
detail: Scoring plays, turnovers, and the last two minutes of each half are reviewed from the booth.

name: Automatic first down
short: Some defensive fouls give a new 1st down.
full: Some defensive fouls, like holding and pass interference, give the offense a new 1st down no matter how far they still had to go.

name: Declined penalty
short: Fouled team can refuse a penalty.
full: The team that was fouled can refuse the penalty if the play's result was better for them.

name: Offsetting penalties
short: Both teams fouled: they cancel, replay the down.
full: Both teams fouled on the same play, so the fouls cancel out and the down is replayed.

name: Half the distance
short: Penalties never move the ball over half the way to the goal.
full: A penalty can never move the ball more than half the distance to the goal line. Near the goal, the penalty shrinks.

name: False start
short: Offense moved before the snap.
full: False start: an offensive player moved before the snap. It's a 5-yard penalty and the play never starts.

name: Offside
short: Defender across the line at the snap.
full: Offside: a defender was across the line of scrimmage when the ball was snapped. It's a 5-yard penalty.

name: Encroachment
short: Defender crossed and touched someone before the snap.
full: Encroachment: a defender crossed the line and touched an offensive player before the snap. It's 5 yards.

name: Neutral zone infraction
short: Defender jumped in and made the offense flinch.
full: Neutral zone infraction: a defender moved into the space at the line and made an offensive player flinch. It's 5 yards.

name: Delay of game
short: Play clock ran out before the snap.
full: Delay of game: the offense didn't snap the ball before the play clock ran out. It's a 5-yard penalty.

name: Illegal formation
short: Offense lined up wrong.
full: Illegal formation: the offense lined up wrong, for example with fewer than 7 players on the line. It's 5 yards.

name: Illegal shift
short: Offense moved illegally before the snap.
full: Illegal shift: offensive players moved illegally before the snap, like not getting set or more than one moving. It's 5 yards.

name: Too many men on the field
short: 12 or more players on the field.
full: Too many men: a team had 12 or more players on the field. It's a 5-yard penalty.

name: Offensive holding
short: A blocker grabbed a defender.
full: Offensive holding: a blocker grabbed or hooked a defender to stop him. It's a 10-yard penalty.

name: Defensive holding
short: Defender grabbed a player without the ball.
full: Defensive holding: a defender grabbed or held a receiver or blocker who didn't have the ball. 5 yards and an automatic first down.

name: Defensive pass interference
short: Defender blocked a receiver's fair chance to catch.
full: Defensive pass interference: a defender blocked a receiver's fair chance to catch a catchable pass. Ball at the spot of the foul, automatic first down.
detail: Ball at the spot of the foul + automatic first down (at the 1 if in the end zone).

name: Offensive pass interference
short: Receiver pushed off while the pass was in the air.
full: Offensive pass interference: a receiver pushed off or blocked a defender while the pass was in the air. It's a 10-yard penalty.

name: Illegal contact
short: Defender contacted a receiver too far downfield.
full: Illegal contact: a defender touched a receiver more than 5 yards downfield before the ball was thrown. 5 yards and an automatic first down.

name: Illegal use of hands
short: Hands to the face or illegal pushing.
full: Illegal use of hands: hands to the face or neck, or illegal pushing. 10 yards on the offense; 5 yards and a first down on the defense.
detail: Offense: 10 yards. Defense: 5 yards + automatic first down.

name: Roughing the passer
short: Late, low, or head hit on the quarterback.
full: Roughing the passer: hitting the quarterback late, low, or in the head after he throws. 15 yards and an automatic first down.

name: Unnecessary roughness
short: A hit beyond what the play needed.
full: Unnecessary roughness: a hit beyond what the play needs, such as after the whistle. It's 15 yards.
detail: 15 yards. On the defense, also an automatic first down.

name: Face mask
short: Grabbed and pulled an opponent's face mask.
full: Face mask: grabbing and twisting or pulling an opponent's face mask. It's a 15-yard penalty.
detail: 15 yards. On the defense, also an automatic first down.

name: Intentional grounding
short: Quarterback threw it away with nobody near.
full: Intentional grounding: a quarterback under pressure threw the ball away with no receiver nearby, from inside the tackle box. Loss of down and at least 10 yards.
detail: Loss of down and at least 10 yards.

name: Illegal block in the back
short: Blocked an opponent from behind.
full: Illegal block in the back: blocking an opponent from behind, above the waist. It's a 10-yard penalty.

name: Tripping
short: Used a leg or foot to trip someone.
full: Tripping: using a leg or foot to trip an opponent. It's a 10-yard penalty.

name: Horse-collar tackle
short: Tackled by grabbing inside the collar.
full: Horse-collar tackle: tackling by grabbing the inside of the back or side collar of the shoulder pads. It's 15 yards.

name: Unsportsmanlike conduct
short: Taunting or other unsportsmanlike acts.
full: Unsportsmanlike conduct: taunting or other unsportsmanlike acts. It's a 15-yard penalty.

name: Roughing the kicker
short: Ran into the kicker hard.
full: Roughing the kicker: running into the kicker hard. 15 yards and an automatic first down.

name: Running into the kicker
short: Minor contact with the kicker.
full: Running into the kicker: minor contact with the kicker. It's 5 yards, with no automatic first down.

name: Fair catch interference
short: Got in the way of a fair catch.
full: Fair catch interference: getting in the way of a returner who signaled for a fair catch. It's 15 yards.

name: Illegal forward pass
short: Pass thrown past the line, or a second forward pass.
full: Illegal forward pass: a forward pass thrown from beyond the line of scrimmage, or a second forward pass. 5 yards and loss of down.

name: Ineligible man downfield
short: Lineman too far downfield on a pass.
full: Ineligible man downfield: a lineman was too far downfield when a pass was thrown. It's a 5-yard penalty.

name: Targeting
short: Forcible hit to the head or neck, or with the helmet's crown.
full: Targeting: a forcible hit to the head or neck of a defenseless player, or leading with the crown of the helmet. 15 yards, and the player is ejected.
detail: 15 yards and the player is disqualified; on the defense, also an automatic first down.

name: Other penalty
short: A rarer foul; listen for the yardage.
full: This is a rarer foul. The referee's announcement names it and gives the yardage.
